name: Eosphorosuchus
sum: Eosphorosuchus is a short-snouted early-diverging crocodylomorph from the Rhaetian Chinle Formation at Ghost Ranch, New Mexico.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: YPM VP 41198 (Yale Peabody Museum): the front of the skull, the rear of the left lower jaw, one neck vertebra, both pubes, most of the left hindlimb and three osteoderms.
biology: A short sturdy skull adapted for a strong bite (English Wikipedia).
author: Margulis-Ohnuma et al. 2026

sources.text: Margulis-Ohnuma, M., Ruebenstahl, A. A., Meyer, D. L. and Bhullar, B.-A. S. 2026. A short-snouted 'sphenosuchian' with unusual feeding anatomy demonstrates that ecological specialization occurred early in crocodylomorph evolution. Proceedings of the Royal Society B 293(2069).

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Rhaetian per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
